hindsight_policy: World data for the FIBA pipeline. Holds format, calendar and (where listed) real entry lists and squads only. No score, result, standing, award or statistic of this event is recorded. Real qualification routes and real group draws describe the real world; a simulated career must derive the field of any edition whose qualifiers it simulates from simulated results, and must not read this file before the dates given in known_from.

known_from.note: Group composition is public from the draw date; the second-round, semifinal and medal pairings depend on results of this event.

rule.value: The two finalists and the two semifinal losers qualify. Argentina was already qualified as 2004 Olympic champion; should Argentina finish in the first four, the fifth-best team of the second round also qualifies.

entry_route.value: automatic: North America sub-zone (USA and Canada are its only members)

roster_kind.value: Professional players from leagues other than the NBA (CBA/NBDL, European and Asian club players), coached by Mo McHone; no NBA roster players. Charlie Bell is listed by the squad page with the Milwaukee Bucks as his club.
